outlook.title: Generic outlook
outlook.within12: A generic version may come out around {{date}}. Prices could go down after that. This date is not a promise. Keep taking your medicine as your doctor told you.
outlook.oneToThree: A generic version may come out in the next few years. We don't know exactly when.
outlook.earliest: Earliest date we know of: {{date}} (not a promised launch date)
outlook.biosimilar: A generic copies a regular medicine. A biosimilar is a very close copy of a biologic medicine, like insulin.

ask.title: Ask your doctor or pharmacist
ask.subtitle: Questions you can ask. This app does not give medical advice.

ask.q3: Can you send it to the pharmacy I choose?
